Volta itself keeps no logs and never collects or sells your activity. All traffic, including DNS and IPv6, goes through the encrypted tunnel. Ads are shown by Google AdMob, which may use an advertising ID if you consent.

This promise is Volta’s, not the servers’. Each server is run by someone else and may keep its own records: volunteer servers can log traffic, and the VPN Gate project keeps connection logs. The sections above explain each kind.

TESTED and UNTESTED locations are volunteer servers of the VPN Gate academic project (University of Tsukuba). Volta checks them every hour for IP leaks, wrong location and HTTPS interception, but cannot check what their operators record: volunteers may log traffic, and the project keeps connection logs (including your real IP) for 3 months or more. They hide you from websites, not from those operators.
Volta uses the OpenVPN for Android engine by Arne Schwabe (GPLv2). Volta\'s source code is published under the same license.

NO-LOG locations are run by Riseup (riseup.net), a donation-funded nonprofit whose stated policy is to keep no logs. Your phone gets its own anonymous certificate from Riseup; nothing ties it to you. If you use them often, please consider donating to Riseup.
Blocks the internet if the VPN drops, so nothing leaks. In Android settings tap ⚙ next to Volta VPN, then turn on “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN”.

For full protection, turn on “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN” for Volta in Android settings (tap ⚙ next to Volta VPN). Then nothing leaves your phone unprotected, even while the connection drops or changes server.
Stops the VPN server from reading your DNS lookups. In Android settings set “Private DNS” to: 1dot1dot1dot1.cloudflare-dns.com
Private DNS is on, so your DNS lookups are encrypted. The safe browsing filters below may not apply while it\'s on.
The VPN hides you from websites and your local network. Only HTTPS (the 🔒 in the browser) hides what you do from the VPN server too. Avoid entering passwords on sites without it.
